rows.grounds: parama (supreme) + advaya (non-dual) + samāveśa (absorption/immersion); nominative subject, denoting the supreme non-dual absorption.
avasthitaḥ (situated/abiding); past passive participle agreeing with paramādvayasamāveśaḥ.
iti (thus); quotative particle marking the preceding statement.
uktaṃ (said/stated); past passive participle, neuter nominative, functioning as predicate.
bhavati (becomes/is); present active verb completing the predication 'thus it is said'.
